reference_cohort_info_part.model_build_note: This study used a pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model (n=37,126, 79 scanners) from Kia et al. 2022 [ref 15]. The model was adapted to the clinical sites but was not built in this paper. Therefore, RCI-1 to RCI-7 extraction is not applicable.
reference_cohort_info_part.model_build_supporting_text: "We used a pre-estimated multi-site reference normative model predicting cortical thickness from age. This model was built from healthy participant data (n = 37,126) across 79 scanners with good coverage through adolescence to late life [15]"
